supporting_observations.claim: The supplied evidence consists of three Sysmon Event ID 13 registry SetValue records on WS-LMARTINS-01, timestamped 13:34:11, 13:42:52, and 14:09:12 UTC.
The UserAssist registry paths in the records encode a Firefox executable path at 13:34 and 14:09, and a Teams shortcut path at 13:42; these records alone do not establish malicious activity.
The supplied records do not include domain authentication events, so they do not corroborate or refute the alert's reported failed logons for leo.martins.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied evidence contains only three Sysmon registry SetValue records; it contains no authentication event records to assess failed or successful domain logons (T031-00001, T031-00004, T031-00006).
These records do not provide source IPs, logon types, authentication results, or the reason for any reported failures.
claims_not_established: Whether repeated failed domain logons occurred during the review window.
Whether any failed logons were followed by a successful logon.
The source of any authentication attempts, their logon types, or whether they were authorized.
Whether the observed UserAssist entries were associated with suspicious activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain controller security logs for the review window, including failed and successful logon events and relevant account or group changes.
Authentication records from WS-LMARTINS-01 and any identified source host, including logon type and process or network context where available.
Endpoint process and network telemetry around the reported failures to correlate any authentication attempts with the observed workstation activity.
